{
  "name": "powerprompt-marketplace",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite dev --port 3000",
    "build": "vite build",
    "start": "node .output/server/index.mjs",
    "preview": "vite preview --port 4173",
    "test:db": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/tests/db.test.ts",
    "test:api": "vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/tests/api.test.ts",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "test": "npm run test:db && npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@tanstack/react-router": "1.170.17",
    "@tanstack/react-start": "1.168.27",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "5.1.2",
    "lucide-react": "0.468.0",
    "vite": "7.2.7",
    "vinxi": "0.5.11",
    "react": "19.2.3",
    "react-dom": "19.2.3",
    "zod": "3.25.76"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "1.57.0",
    "@tanstack/router-plugin": "1.168.19",
    "@types/node": "22.19.0",
    "@types/react": "19.2.7",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.2.3",
    "playwright": "1.57.0",
    "typescript": "5.9.3",
    "vitest": "4.0.15"
  }
}
